name: Camp Frederick Douglass
description_short: A YMCA day camp at the New Bedford YMCA, open weekdays from 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. Campers do gym and outdoor games, swimming, archery and drama, and learn about Frederick Douglass and his time in New Bedford through projects, field trips and museum visits.
refund_policy_summary: $50 non-refundable deposit per session per child at registration; tuition due in full 6/1 (Sessions A-C), 7/1 (D-F) and 8/1 (G-J). Withdrawal needs four weeks' written notice for a refund less the deposit; refunds after camp starts only for illness or injury with a doctor's note. $25 fee for approved session changes.
